steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education. No prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for early-career professionals across Aerospace & Defense, Government, Healthcare, and Manufacturing sectors seeking to formalize their PM foundation.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application & Fee
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your PMI application with proof of your 23 contact hours and secondary degree. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Our team provides guidance on application submission to ensure your credentials are processed accurately and on time.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and study materials tailored to CAPM's knowledge domains. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner when ready. Many Warner Robins professionals complete their exam within weeks of finishing the course.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your CAPM, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs). Pursue PDUs through additional training, conference attendance, and volunteer project leadership—common pathways for advancing into the Defense Contracting and Engineering Services careers in your region.
